Application Data.NAME: Cedar Valley Beverage Distributors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cedar Valley Beverage Distributors is a full-service beverage distribution company specializing in the wholesale and retail of a diverse selection of alcoholic beverages, including beer, liquor, and wine. Our operations include the sourcing of products from licensed suppliers, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations. We prioritize responsible serving practices and conduct regular staff training on age verification and responsible beverage service. Our retail location features state-of-the-art security systems, including video surveillance and alarm systems, to protect our high-value inventory. Additionally, we offer online sales, adhering to all shipping regulations, including age verification checks at delivery. Our commitment to operational excellence and regulatory compliance positions us as a preferred distributor in the beverage industry.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Cedar Valley Events LLC, 2345 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62702-3456; a catering service specializing in beverage services for private events and corporate functions.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, Cedar Valley Beverage Distributors reported a minor theft incident where approximately $5,000 worth of liquor was stolen from the retail location due to a break-in. The theft was reported to the police and a claim was filed with our insurance provider. The claim is currently under review, and we have implemented additional security measures, including enhanced alarm systems and increased surveillance to prevent future incidents.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: High-security fencing with monitored access control and a dedicated watchperson during operational hours.
